name: [🕷️] CHILDHOODS :)
desc:
CHILDHOODS 👩‍👧‍👦
Form a child. 👼
Get a job. 🔨
Make a living. 💸
Ascend your kids. ✨

🌟 Please consider liking! It encourages updates for the game! 🌟

THIS GAME IS IN ALPHA: Please report any bugs in the community server (Try to include as many details as possible) and to ask for help!

You find yourself challenged with the task of raising a healthy family amidst the dangers of the city you're stuck in.
Yes, there is crime, monsters, and famine, but with the right planning, your kids will thrive.
Keep your family indoors at night.

A remaster of RAISE A CHILD
